result: RecA filaments slide along dsDNA via 1D diffusion, as demonstrated by FRET fluctuations that depend on filament length, with cross-correlation times increasing linearly with filament length and independent of salt concentration or ATP hydrolysis. Three-color FRET experiments showing anticorrelated emissions between two acceptors provide additional support for the sliding model.
